item.title: Good Morning Family - 15 November 2026
item.description:
Good morning Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Sunday, the 15 November.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be rainy, with a low of 9 degrees and a top of 19 degrees.
There is about a 47 percent chance of rain.
It sounds like a good day for comfy clothes.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is G.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter G?
. . .
